thread:
claire: FYI: hybrid-tier pricing experiment (cohort 'hybrid-lite') is scheduled for TOMORROW 04:00 PT. This combines a small per-token uplift + a reduced base seat fee. Need final reconciliation plan and CFO sign-off on exposure limits. @mohit @sam_fin please confirm.

mohit: I'm running a combined invoice preview now. Main things we're watching: (1) seat allocation pro-rates, (2) vendor passthrough for GPU minutes, (3) exchange-rate rounding for multi-currency invoices. ETA 90m.

sam_fin: Finance needs preflight by 10:30 PT with columns: acct_id, currency, old_total, new_total, delta_usd_equiv, action (auto-credit/manual). Flag deltas > $400. Also want an exposure summary for CFO.

cfo_jess: Quick ask: cap our net cohort liability at $25k. If projected net delta > $25k, auto-halt rollout. Also I want top 10 accounts contributing to exposure.

ops-bot: billing-preview job queued (id=34901) for cohort hybrid-lite. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/34901

mohit: Found one vendor mismatch: GPU passthrough uses vendor_sheet v7 which changed rate units (per-second -> per-minute) and we missed the conversion in the invoice calc. Fixing mapping gpu_seconds -> vendor_gpu_min conversion factor. Adding validation: vendor_charge_calc vs recorded_vendor_charge diff > 1% => flag.

billing-bot: preview job finished. Summary link: https://files.redwood/preflight/34901/preflight_hybrid-lite.csv

sam_fin: Downloaded. Summary: cohort projected net delta +$18,450 USD, avg delta +0.7%, 5 accounts > $400 flagged. Vendor mismatch currently flagged on 2 accounts (conversion unit bug). Mohit, can you patch and re-run?

mohit: Patch in flight. Will rerun and push corrected preview. Also added guard to convert vendor seconds -> minutes using ceil(seconds/60).

claire: Legal asked for grandfathering exceptions for trial-enterprise and education accounts for 30 days. Tag name: gf_30d_edu_trial. Legal approved invoice copy: "You have been granted temporary legacy pricing for 30 days where applicable." Is that ok?

legal: That's fine. Also recommend adding a billing-help link to the invoice for details.

billing-bot: Re-run complete (id=34902). New preflight link: https://files.redwood/preflight/34902/preflight_hybrid-lite_v2.csv. Summary: net delta +$17,980 USD, vendor mismatches resolved, 3 accounts > $400 flagged, no negative deltas. Top exposure contributors: acct_1042 ($4,200), acct_773 ($3,900), acct_221 ($2,800).

cfo_jess: Exposure ok (under $25k) but get me a TTL on manual refund turnaround for the top flagged accounts. Finance SLA?

sam_fin: We can issue auto-credits up to $500. Manual refunds for >$500 will be processed within 2 business days if ops provides an approved ticket. We'll route flagged items to #finance-ops and ping @cfo_jess for approvals.

claire: Rollback gating: pause if net cohort delta > 12% OR billing error rate > 0.9% OR any vendor mismatch unresolved after 2 attempts. Rollback action: toggle cohort routing to rp_stable, revert rate assignment, and trigger immediate preview rerun. Ops runbook: https://playbooks/redwood/hybrid-lite-rollback

ops-bot: Deploy: pricing-hybrid-lite canary started at 2200000023 :rocket: (monitoring on)

mohit: Deploy note: ETL patch for vendor unit conversion deployed successfully. Will keep an eye on monitoring.

sam_fin: Final checklist: preflight posted \u2705, vendor conversion fixed \u2705, gf_30d_edu_trial tag added \u2705, CFO exposure approved \u2705. Launching tomorrow 04:00 PT. If anything trips alerts, we'll pause and reconvene.

claire: Thanks everyone. I'll post a short summary email to stakeholders after the first 2 hours of traffic.
